description: Atos de Outorgas de Geração is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Contem os documentos emitidos pela ANEEL referentes aos empreendimentos de geração a partir de 2015. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are DRI, DRO, DRS, Outorgas, atos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
